body:
This PR adds the same "Getting started" example for all flavors of the monorepo. Most of the other examples are more complex, so this should allow people to iterate more easily when contributing on the library.

CodeSandboxes:
- [InstantSearch.js](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/instantsearch/tree/chore/getting-started-examples/examples/js/getting-started?file=/src/app.js)
- [React InstantSearch](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/instantsearch/tree/chore/getting-started-examples/examples/react/getting-started)
- [React InstantSearch Hooks](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/instantsearch/tree/chore/getting-started-examples/examples/react-hooks/getting-started?file=/src/App.tsx)
- [Vue InstantSearch](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/instantsearch/tree/chore/getting-started-examples/examples/vue/getting-started)

FX-2164
